paraphrase: Six kinds of renouncer: kuṭīcaka (topknot, thread, staff, water-pot; eats in one place), bahūdaka (eight mouthfuls of alms from many houses), haṃsa (matted hair, alms unplanned), paramahaṃsa (no topknot or thread; alms from five houses, hand as bowl; one loincloth; bamboo staff; ash), turīyātīta (like a cow, takes food in the mouth; naked; body as corpse) and avadhūta (no rule; takes food like the python from all castes except the fallen).
